name: Notable
description: The recovered Notable repository documents that newer app versions are unavailable and does not provide the updater implementation needed to substantiate the claimed electron-updater SHA512 and Authenticode controls.
limitations: The recovered default-branch snapshot is newly retrieved and is not the original study checkout.

The implementation for the claimed historical release, including updater invocation, SHA512 handling, and Authenticode enforcement, is absent; the repository points to older tags but they were not treated as the claimed release without a release-specific audit.
